title: The Ballr Cap by Dynavap
description:
The BALLR Cap
Breath some new life into your Dynavap experience with the BALLR cap. As the name suggests, the Ballr cap is loaded with stainless steel balls. These little gems very efficiently release heat into the air as it passes by on its way to your herb. This results in a very tasty powerful experience.
Designed for enhanced convection heating, this extended-length cap features a perforated design that improves airflow and heat distribution, ensuring smooth, flavorful vapor with every draw.
Preloaded with stainless steel balls, the BallR Cap increases heat retention for a more consistent experience, whether using a torch or induction heater*. Built for versatility, this stainless steel Cap fits seamlessly onto any standard DynaVap tip, making it the perfect add-on to your favorite thermal extraction setup.
The BallR Cap is perfect for those who want the ball vape experience in a portable form factor with DynaVap modularity. This cap is a budget-friendly upgrade that lets you enhance any DynaVap setup by converting it to a portable ball vape.
BENEFITS
Enhanced Vapor Quality:
Convection-focused design for smoother, tastier vapor.
Improved Heat Retention:
Preloaded stainless steel balls ensure even extraction and consistent convection while heating with a torch or induction heater*.
Versatility:
Compatible with any standard DynaVap tip for seamless integration.
Ease of Use:
Heating indicator works with torches and induction heaters for precise control.
Durability:
Built to last with high-quality materials and DynaVap’s signature craftsmanship.
Convenience:
Retains classic cap features like the digger outer and DynaVap’s click when ready indicator.
FEATURES
Extended-length cap:
Designed for optimal convection heating
Universal fit:
Works with any standard DynaVap tip
Perforated cap design:
Allows for better airflow and heat control
Preloaded with stainless steel balls:
For increased mass and enhanced vaporization
Heating indicator:
For torch or induction heater use
Included
1 X BALLR CAP (Pre loaded with stainless steel balls)
